name: @btkulka/ableton-als
description: Reads Ableton Live documents (.als sets, .adg racks, .adv presets: gzipped XML): gunzip/gzip, the root header (Live version, document type, the is-this-Ableton check), every file reference across Live 9-12 layouts, the samples a set is missing (project-relative resolution, Splice detection, search keys), and a watermark-comment helper. A small lenient tag scanner, no XML library. Node only, no runtime dependencies.
